I do not have money to buy chemical fertilizer or pesticides from the shop, and I have kept my own sorghum seed from last season to plant this year. I will put cow manure on the plot because we have a few animals, and my family will do all the work ourselves since hiring labor costs too much. We depend on the rains here in Mtwara, so I cannot irrigate. This is how we have always managed, and it has fed my household.
